# Module execution harness.
#
# Builds a module manager image per test, each embedding the modules it loads,
# for one Cortex-M module port, and runs every image on QEMU's MPS2 board for
# that core, asserting the result each image reports over semihosting.
#
# Why this exists: the host tests under test/tx/module_manager compile a few
# module manager sources against stubs, and nothing else in CI runs a Cortex-M
# module port at all.  A module's start-up, its kernel calls through the
# supervisor call, the MPU programming on every context switch and the fault
# path that terminates a misbehaving module are only exercised by executing
# them.  This is the per-architecture part of the module test strategy; the
# portable module manager code is meant to be covered on the host.
#
# Its own top-level project, like test/tx/cmake/riscv, because it cross-builds
# with a bare-metal toolchain and runs under an emulator, which the host suite
# beside it does neither of.
#
# Configure once per port:
#
#   cmake -S test/tx/cmake/module_qemu -B build/module_qemu_m3 -G Ninja \
#         -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=$PWD/test/tx/cmake/module_qemu/arm-none-eabi-qemu.cmake \
#         -DMODULE_QEMU_PORT=cortex_m3
#   cmake --build build/module_qemu_m3
#   ctest --test-dir build/module_qemu_m3 --output-on-failure
#
# MODULE_QEMU_PORT is cortex_m3 (QEMU mps2-an385) or cortex_m4 (mps2-an386,
# built for its FPU with the hard-float ABI).

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20 FATAL_ERROR)

project(threadx_module_qemu LANGUAGES C ASM)

set(MODULE_QEMU_PORT "cortex_m3" CACHE STRING "Cortex-M module port to build and run")
set_property(CACHE MODULE_QEMU_PORT PROPERTY STRINGS cortex_m3 cortex_m4)

if(MODULE_QEMU_PORT STREQUAL "cortex_m3")
    set(PORT_CPU_FLAGS -mcpu=cortex-m3 -mthumb)
    set(QEMU_MACHINE mps2-an385)
elseif(MODULE_QEMU_PORT STREQUAL "cortex_m4")
    set(PORT_CPU_FLAGS -mcpu=cortex-m4 -mthumb -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard)
    set(QEMU_MACHINE mps2-an386)
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "MODULE_QEMU_PORT must be cortex_m3 or cortex_m4, not '${MODULE_QEMU_PORT}'")
endif()

set(REPO_ROOT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../..)
set(PORT_DIR ${REPO_ROOT}/ports_module/${MODULE_QEMU_PORT}/gnu)
set(HARNESS_SRC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src)
set(HARNESS_TESTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/tests)

message(STATUS "Module port: ${MODULE_QEMU_PORT}, QEMU machine: ${QEMU_MACHINE}")

add_compile_options(${PORT_CPU_FLAGS} -g -O0 -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections)
add_link_options(${PORT_CPU_FLAGS})

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The kernel and the Module Manager, built with the module port's headers.
#
# One library, not the threadx library plus the manager: the module port's
# tx_port.h adds the owning module to the kernel's control blocks, so a kernel
# built against the base port and a manager built against this one would
# disagree about every object while linking without complaint.  tx_misra.c is
# left out because nothing here builds with TX_MISRA_ENABLE.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

file(GLOB TX_COMMON_SRC ${REPO_ROOT}/common/src/*.c)
list(FILTER TX_COMMON_SRC EXCLUDE REGEX ".*/tx_misra\\.c$")
file(GLOB TXM_PORT_SRC
     ${PORT_DIR}/module_manager/src/*.S
     ${PORT_DIR}/module_manager/src/*.s
     ${PORT_DIR}/module_manager/src/*.c)
file(GLOB TXM_MANAGER_SRC ${REPO_ROOT}/common_modules/module_manager/src/*.c)

add_library(threadx_module STATIC ${TX_COMMON_SRC} ${TXM_PORT_SRC} ${TXM_MANAGER_SRC})
target_include_directories(threadx_module PUBLIC
    ${PORT_DIR}/inc
    ${REPO_ROOT}/common/inc
    ${REPO_ROOT}/common_modules/inc
    ${REPO_ROOT}/common_modules/module_manager/inc)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The module-side library: the API shims that run inside a module.  It belongs
# to the module images only; linked into a manager it would redirect the
# manager's own service calls into a module.
#
# Position independent, as everything in a module must be:
#   -fpic / -fpie                    data references go through the GOT
#   -msingle-pic-base                r9 is the GOT base, set by the manager's
#                                    thread stack build
#   -mno-pic-data-is-text-relative   data is allocated from the manager's pool,
#                                    not at a fixed offset from the code
#   -fno-plt                         no procedure linkage table to populate
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

set(MODULE_PIC_FLAGS -fno-plt -mno-pic-data-is-text-relative -msingle-pic-base)

file(GLOB TXM_MODULE_LIB_SRC
     ${REPO_ROOT}/common_modules/module_lib/src/*.c
     ${PORT_DIR}/module_lib/src/*.c)

add_library(txm_module_lib STATIC ${TXM_MODULE_LIB_SRC})
target_include_directories(txm_module_lib PUBLIC
    ${PORT_DIR}/inc
    ${REPO_ROOT}/common/inc
    ${REPO_ROOT}/common_modules/inc)
target_compile_options(txm_module_lib PRIVATE -fpic ${MODULE_PIC_FLAGS})

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A test module: one source, built with a given preamble property word, linked
# with the port's module linker script, and reduced to the raw image a manager
# embeds.  The script defines the code and data sizes the preamble reports.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function(module_qemu_add_module name source properties)
    add_executable(${name}.elf
        ${HARNESS_SRC}/module_preamble.S
        ${PORT_DIR}/example_build/gcc_setup.s
        ${source})
    target_include_directories(${name}.elf PRIVATE ${HARNESS_SRC})
    target_compile_definitions(${name}.elf PRIVATE TEST_MODULE_PROPERTIES=${properties})
    target_compile_options(${name}.elf PRIVATE -fpie ${MODULE_PIC_FLAGS})
    target_link_libraries(${name}.elf PRIVATE txm_module_lib)
    target_link_options(${name}.elf PRIVATE
        -T${PORT_DIR}/example_build/sample_threadx_module.ld
        -nostartfiles
        -nostdlib
        -Wl,-pie
        -Wl,--no-dynamic-linker
        -Wl,-e,_txm_module_thread_shell_entry
        -Wl,--no-warn-rwx-segments
        -Wl,-Map=${name}.map)
    set_target_properties(${name}.elf PROPERTIES
        LINK_DEPENDS ${PORT_DIR}/example_build/sample_threadx_module.ld)

    set(bin ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${name}.bin)
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${bin}
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} -O binary $<TARGET_FILE:${name}.elf> ${bin}
        DEPENDS ${name}.elf
        COMMENT "Converting ${name} to a raw module image"
        VERBATIM)
    add_custom_target(${name}_bin DEPENDS ${bin})

    # The blob that embeds the image in a manager, as bytes, under the module's
    # name as its symbol.
    set(BLOB_SYMBOL ${name})
    set(BLOB_FILE ${bin})
    configure_file(${HARNESS_SRC}/module_blob.S.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${name}_blob.S @ONLY)
    set_source_files_properties(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${name}_blob.S PROPERTIES OBJECT_DEPENDS ${bin})
endfunction()

# GNU compiler ID in bits 31-24; bit 0 user mode, bit 1 memory protection,
# bit 2 shared memory access.
module_qemu_add_module(module_services_protected  ${HARNESS_TESTS}/module_services.c 0x02000007)
module_qemu_add_module(module_services_privileged ${HARNESS_TESTS}/module_services.c 0x02000000)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The manager images, one per test, and the CTest entries that run them.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter)
find_program(QEMU_SYSTEM_ARM qemu-system-arm)

enable_testing()

function(module_qemu_add_test name test_source)
    set(blobs ${ARGN})
    set(blob_sources "")
    foreach(blob IN LISTS blobs)
        list(APPEND blob_sources ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${blob}_blob.S)
    endforeach()

    add_executable(${name}.elf
        ${HARNESS_SRC}/startup.S
        ${HARNESS_SRC}/tx_initialize_low_level.S
        ${HARNESS_SRC}/harness.c
        ${HARNESS_TESTS}/harness_checks.c
        ${test_source}
        ${blob_sources})
    target_include_directories(${name}.elf PRIVATE ${HARNESS_SRC} ${HARNESS_TESTS})
    target_link_libraries(${name}.elf PRIVATE threadx_module)
    target_link_options(${name}.elf PRIVATE
        -T${HARNESS_SRC}/manager.ld
        -nostartfiles
        --specs=nano.specs
        --specs=nosys.specs
        -Wl,--gc-sections
        -Wl,--no-warn-rwx-segments
        -Wl,-Map=${name}.map)
    set_target_properties(${name}.elf PROPERTIES LINK_DEPENDS ${HARNESS_SRC}/manager.ld)
    foreach(blob IN LISTS blobs)
        add_dependencies(${name}.elf ${blob}_bin)
    endforeach()

    if(Python3_FOUND AND QEMU_SYSTEM_ARM)
        add_test(NAME ${MODULE_QEMU_PORT}::${name}
                 COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/run_qemu_test.py
                         --qemu ${QEMU_SYSTEM_ARM}
                         --machine ${QEMU_MACHINE}
                         --elf $<TARGET_FILE:${name}.elf>)
    endif()
endfunction()

module_qemu_add_test(test_module_lifecycle  ${HARNESS_TESTS}/test_module_lifecycle.c  module_services_protected)
module_qemu_add_test(test_module_fault      ${HARNESS_TESTS}/test_module_fault.c      module_services_protected)
module_qemu_add_test(test_module_privileged ${HARNESS_TESTS}/test_module_privileged.c module_services_privileged)

if(NOT (Python3_FOUND AND QEMU_SYSTEM_ARM))
    message(STATUS "qemu-system-arm or Python 3 not found; the images build but no tests are registered.")
endif()
